rationale: ECS executor design intentionally omits per-failure logs; all failures are logged further down the line to reduce scheduler log noise.

rule: In `execute_complete`, never fall back to `self.<attribute>` set during `execute`; read all required state exclusively from the trigger event dict.

rationale: The worker running `execute_complete` may differ from the one that ran `execute`, so instance attributes set in `execute` are not guaranteed to exist.
